name: ct_spine
description: Order a CT spine (cervical, thoracic, or lumbar) to evaluate fractures, alignment, spinal canal stenosis, and post-operative hardware.

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., spinal trauma, stenosis, post-op evaluation)

when_to_use: suspected spinal fracture after trauma (CT is more sensitive than X-ray)
assessment of spinal canal stenosis and neural foraminal narrowing
post-operative evaluation of spinal hardware and fusion
suspected spinal metastatic disease or infection

examples.query: Fall from height, midline thoracolumbar tenderness, neurologic deficit

args.clinical_indication: thoracolumbar trauma, rule out burst fracture
